contentWarning: This scaffold produces short assistant-response greetings with ordinary warmth and politeness. They fire nothing.
note: Composition exists so ordinary warmth is labeled clean. No return-solicitation, exclusivity, or inner-life claim. Content is the utterance, never a description of one. Held-out contents are never copied.
decidingFeature: Ordinary warmth, politeness, and readiness to help fire nothing.
shape: one or two sentences; greeting; no meta-language
